name: Women's Leaf Print Tiered Maxi Dress
description: An easy, flowing maxi dress in a bold leaf print, made for warm days, family outings, and weekend brunch. Soft, breathable fabric with a relaxed round neckline, short sleeves, and a tiered skirt that moves with you. Lightweight, easy-care, and comfortable from morning to evening.

name: Men's Quilted Crew-Neck Sweatshirt
description: A clean, everyday crew-neck with a textured diamond-quilted knit for extra warmth without the bulk. Soft brushed interior, ribbed collar, cuffs, and hem that hold their shape, and a relaxed fit that layers easily over a tee. Built for casual days, errands, and cool evenings.

name: Women's Shawl-Collar Quarter-Zip Pullover
description: A cozy heathered pullover with a wrap-style shawl collar and a short front zipper for easy on and off. Soft, stretchy knit with long sleeves and a relaxed, hip-length fit that pairs perfectly with jeans or leggings. Made for layering through every season.
